description: This is a Java test class for the HashingService, containing unit tests that verify the correctness and consistency of the consistentHash method in various scenarios.

classes.name: HashingServiceTest
classes.description: Test class for HashingService, testing hash consistency, handling negative inputs, and bucket range inclusion.

methods.name: testConsistentHashGeneratesHashesConsistentlyForTheSameValue
methods.description: Verifies that consistentHash produces the same value for the same input repeatedly.

methods.name: testConsistentHashWorksForNegativeValues
methods.description: Checks that consistentHash handles negative input values properly by producing a result within expected bucket range.

methods.name: testConsistentHashGeneratesHashesWithinBuckets
methods.description: Ensures that the hash results are always less than the number of buckets, for a large number of random inputs.
